title: The Lighthouse Keeper
content: Every evening, old Mara climbed the ninety-two steps of the lighthouse. She polished the great lens until it gleamed, then lit the lamp just as the sun slipped beneath the waves. Sailors far out at sea had never met her, yet they trusted her completely. On stormy nights she stayed awake until dawn, watching the beam sweep across the water and knowing that somewhere out there a ship was finding its way home.

title: Morning
content:
The sun peeks over sleepy hills,
And gold spills on the window sills.
The birds begin their cheerful song,
To call the day to come along.
